101304.description: Shy, nerdy Komatsu Kaede has never had any friends or lovers, and on top of that is plagued by low self-esteem and problems at his job. One day, when his life is at an all-time low, he accidentally/on impulse enlists the services of a male escort. This turns out to be the first of many meetings with the beautiful, charming and self-assured "Sakura"...

101305.description:
Nagi who was summoned to another world acquired the「Skill Structure」skill.

Nagi felt the hints of black job from the king’s request 「To defeat the devil king」. He leaves the castle and starts his journey with a slave girl.

The small demon girl Cecyl, the melee-fighter beast girl Rita , Aine the onee-chan maid, Regii the cursed sword.

Rafiria the warm and fluffy elf and Iris the sea dragon shrine maiden.

Nagi rewrites the girls’ skills and made them into 「cheat characters」one after another.

(Source: NU)
synonyms: Being Able to Edit Skills in Another World

title.native: 異世界でスキルを解体したらチートな嫁が増殖しました 概念交差のストラクチャー
title.romaji: Isekai de Skill wo Kaitai Shitara Cheat na Yome ga Zoushoku Shimashita: Gainen Kousa no Structure

101306.description: This spin-off tells the story of the girls who have the VR-Virus and live on the island of Bhikkhuni.

title.native: ヴァルキリードライヴ ビクニズム

101307.description:
A young yarn shop owner, Mao Rong, was raised to believe love could touch people’s lives. That all changed when he met Yang Yusheng, a popular but rude artist disgusted by the touch of other people. After accidentally injuring Yang Yusheng’s hand, Mao Rong promises to nurse him back to good health. Cooking, cleaning, Mao Rong does his best to make things right despite Yang Yusheng telling him he’s doing everything wrong. Little does he know Mao Rong’s touch is the first that makes him feel… good.

Can Mao Rong knit Yang Yusheng back together? And why is Yang Yusheng afraid of skin contact? The strings of fate have been tied together!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

101308.description:
A one-shot about a strange curse visited on a family after an archaeological dig.

One-shot in celebration of 30 years of Itou Junji's career.

101311.description:
One day, high-school student Koyomi Araragi catches a girl named Hitagi Senjougahara when she trips. But—much to his surprise—she doesn’t weigh anything. At all. She says an encounter with a so-called “crab” took away all her weight …

Monsters have been here since the beginning.
Always.
Everywhere.

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: ปกรณัมของเหล่าภูต

101312.description: Kirishima Naoto is handsome, hard-working and popular with his female co-workers, but has one major shortcoming: his extreme adoration towards his younger brother, Hokuto. Swearing off a proper romantic relationship for Hokuto's sake, Naoto frequently spends the evenings with his friend from college, Toudou. Though he knows that Toudou's gay, Naoto has never held it against him... Until one day, when he discovers that Toudou and Hokuto have been texting each other in secret and declares "If you promise not to touch my brother, I will take his place"!?

title.native: 恋愛なんてゆるしません！

101315.description:
Seto, a studious but unremarkable student, constantly finds himself in provocative situations with Anjo, the popular girl in his class who can't seem to stop teasing him. A heart-pounding teen rom-com bursting with youthful passion!

(Source: Emaqi)

Note: This is a serialisation of the web comic originally self-published on Pixiv.
synonyms: คุณอันโจหยอกนักเพราะรักนะ

title.native: やんちゃギャルの安城さん

101319.description: Featuring Hokuto, Naoto's brother from Renai Nante Yurushimasen, and his lover.

title.native: 恋愛なんていたしません!

101320.description:
The world-renowned Louvre museum in Paris contains more than just the most famous works of art in history. At night, within its darkened galleries, an unseen and surreal world comes alive—a world witnessed only by the small family of cats that lives in the attic. Until now…

(Source: VIZ Media)

101321.description: Lost in an Otome-Game!? A heart-pounding, inescapable, virtual love!!

title.native: ロックアッププリンス

101323.description:
Sueoka is popular and friendly to all of his classmates, but he hates being around people. Hiding during lunch in the bathroom, Sueoka ends up hearing two of his male classmates having sex! Stuck in the bathroom, Sueoka has no choice but to endure through the entire thing. However, he is somehow caught!!

"If you don't want me to tell anyone, suck me off." Blackmailed by the quiet Oohashi, what will be Sueoka's decision? Hide his true self or let it be revealed to the world?

101324.description:
Kaoru Kamisawa doesn't have your run-of-the-mill job. He makes his living by cutting ties for people by literally cutting the invisible string that connects them to each other. One day, he meets Hara, who comes to him in desparation to get a woman to stop stalking him. Hara is a little skeptical at first, but gradually starts having feelings for Kaoru. But, Kaoru knows it won't last. His special gift also robs him of his own "red string of fate" that connects a person to the partner they're destined for. Kaoru tries to keep Hara away, but can he...?

(Source: Renta!)

101325.description: Since the death of his grandfather, Nakaruma Haru has closed the bakery that they ran together, and wrestled with the future. Having made the decision to re-open the bakery alone, he visits the cemetery to inform his grandfather. There he sees a strange man who appears to be an undertaker visiting the graves. Later on, when the same man appears taking shelter from the rain outside of his shop, he impulsively invites him in and offers him a room for the night.

title.native: 東雲さん、いつまでいるの?

101326.description:
1-3. Shinigami no Koi
A grim reaper watches a man who has lost his wife through his crystal ball, but when he has to take the man's life, he is hesitant.

4. Oazuke Kachou (Section Chief Oazuke)

5. Yumeshima

6. Something in Memory

101327.description: Ichinose Kei has learned kendo from the time he was a child for one reason: to be Mita Hikaru’s hero. The two were always together when they were children until Hikaru had to move. Now in high school, the two meet once again, but Hikaru is now trying to be Kei’s hero?!

title.native: サムライアイスクリーム

101328.description:
Recently dumped, and very straight, Shizuma tries to drink his sorrow away, only to wake up being spooned by a man! When he explains to Minato, his drunken fling, that he doesn’t remember a thing about their night together, Minato secretly vows to seduce him again—and then dump him as revenge! But even the best-laid plans can go awry when Cupid has his way.

(Source: SuBLime)

101329.description:
After stalking one another, high school teacher Takatsu and former student Mizusawa finally start dating. Mizusawa, once a cheeky high schooler, is now a good-looking younger boyfriend to Takasu. A middle-aged man, Takasu isn’t accustomed to dating someone like Mizusawa and having his unrequited love requited. This volume is a collection of stories focusing on Takasu and Mizusawa as they date and build a life together over the years.

(Source: Manga Planet)
synonyms: ヤング グッド ボーイフレンド

101330.description: Outgoing Tsurugi and the shy Kiyou are the best of friends. As Kiyou’s attraction to his friend grows stronger, so does the pressure to be “normal”. Unable to come to terms with these feelings, Kiyou and his friends relationship arrives at a breaking point. Tsurugi disappears and Kiyou resumes his life as a “normal” … That is until one day with high school graduation just around the corner, Kiyou is shocked to find that his childhood friend has waltzed back into his life as if nothing ever happened…?

title.native: どうしようもない恋情

101331.description:
In a world where horns are the defining trait of magic beings, larger horns mean more powerful magic! Eru, a freshman at a school for magic, is self-conscious about how tiny his horns are compared to those of his new classmates -- Not only is his magic so weak it is barely noticeable, but things have a habit of going awry when he is around. He is the complete opposite of Rihito, one of the top students of their grade with exceptionally strong magic...who is Eru's roommate!? And already seems to hate him!?
With their continued encounters, will Eru continue to discover just how inferior his strength is? Or maybe, he just might find some power of his own...

(Source: Yen Press)

101332.description:
Momo, a creature of beauty, suddenly appears before student doctor Rintaro, but it seems Momo may have a secret. Momo wants to start a family with Rintaro, but why and what exactly is Momo?

(Source: Tokyo Otaku Mode)

title.native: ログ・ホライズン カナミ、ゴー！イースト！

101335.description:
Teenage history buff Shizuko Ayanokoji is a student at a specialized agricultural high school. One day, just as she's walking home from school, she suddenly finds herself transported back in time to the Sengoku Period…and who then appears before her but warlord Oda Nobunaga himself?! Captured by Nobunaga's army, Shizuko immediately vows to prove her agricultural expertise to him, but can she really fulfill this promise?

(Source: emaqi)

title.native: 戦国小町苦労譚 農耕戯画

101341.description:
1-3, 8) Urusai kurai no Kokuhaku Kudasai (うるさいくらいの告白ください)
Hayashida, who has a super power with the ability to hear the voice of others’ hearts, dreams of meeting his “person of destiny” who he can not hear their hearts voice. One day, he notices the fact that no voice can be heard from the captain of the soccer club.
“I will definitely meet someone who is my destiny, I will definitely love them.”
While staring at the captain with such a longing feeling in his heart, he feels calm even sitting next to the loud Mori senpai who only thinks about his love for boobs. Sachimo brings a story about uncontrollable love between a Psychic and his school mate.

4-7) Seishun Kinema (性春キネマ)
In every class, there is that one person who belongs to the flashiest group who can get along with any one. And on the other side is that one person who is always alone and that no one rarely talks to. In the classroom, you would never expect these two completely different types of people to meet. However, these two have more in common than they believe.
synonyms: Confess to me Loud and Clear

title.native: うるさいくらいの告白ください

101346.description:
The story is adapted from the light novel of the same name. Sayama Takahiro, a carefree high school student, was transported to a fantasy world identical to the one in a VR Game. His go-with-the-flow attitude eventually overpowered his desire to return home, and now he runs Free Life, a small business dedicated to fulfilling the requests of its customers. Assisted by the hard-working Yumiel, what kinds of jobs will Sayama end up doing? If only someone would hire him to sleep till noon.

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title.native: フリーライフ～異世界何でも屋奮闘記～

101353.description: At the "Mikazuchi Dormitories" where the male high school students reside, there is a bright and popular Dormitory Captain, Amano and his supportive helper, the Vice Dormitary Captain Hanyuu. Amano always joked and called Hanyuu his "Wife" and even continued to deepen their relationship. But, for Hanyuu, that only continued to hurt him as he held onto his unrequited love for the past 3 years...

101355.description:
How to be a chef when you lose your sense of taste? For starters, get a hacked knife! There are also these lucky draws and a gorgeous mentor. And that's how a master chef is born!

(Source: WebComics)

101356.description:
For four years, Shougo Natsuka has loved his popular, perfect, and handsome classmate Hiro Hakushima. Out of fear of ruining Hiro's reputation, Shougo never confessed his feelings and remained his friend over the years. Now in college, Shougo has started sleeping with Seno, a sex friend that is the exact opposite of Hiro. Shougo settles into a life with staying by Hiro's side as his friend and releasing his urges on Seno. But, when Seno and Hiro experience a body-switch after an accident, will Shougo finally be able to touch Hiro through Seno's body?

(Source: Futekiya)

101357.description:
A 13 year old girl named Ray awoke in the bottom of the building. She lost her memory and could not understand why she was there. It appeared there was a murderer, Zack, that was covered in a whole body bandage.
"I have a wish, please kill me"
"Help me get out of here with you, I will kill you then."
The strange ties between them will deepen their promises. Where are they supposed to be? For what purpose were they confined? What fate is to await them? A mission to escape from a sealed building begins...! The completely novelized version appears!

(Source: Amazon, translated)
synonyms: ทูตสวรรค์ ทัณฑ์อำมหิต

101362.description:
In a magical world where demons threaten humankind, a young woman with a magic sword rises up to be their champion! There’s just one problem: the reigning demon lord is a baby, and she can’t exactly slay a baby. Even if this domineering demon baby has crass tastes and evil DNA, she believes he can be turned to the side of good with the right influence. Unfortunately, she’s forced to test the theory when a contract binds her to the baby demon lord as his surrogate parent until he performs enough good deeds to prove his worth. What kind of role is that for a mighty hero? Oh, mama!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Chapter count includes 15.5 in volume 3
synonyms: I'm Going to Be the Devil's Mama!

title.native: 魔王のママになるんだよ！

101363.description:
Gen Higaki becomes the bodyguard of the selfish tsundere, Carlo. At first Gen thinks Carlo is nothing more than a spoiled, pretty, young master, but the rare lonely expressions on Carlo’s face may prove otherwise. Also includes the story of Justino and his servant, Cardil.

(Source: xiaojiangworld)

101364.description:
Takara was six years old when a transfer student from the city came and destroyed his tranquil life. 20 years flew by with constant fighting, and before they knew it, they were married.

His partner, Kyosuke Saionji, is misanthropic, stubborn, and arrogant. His cynicism is wasted on his handsome face. Takara fights to tame Kyosuke every day, but despite his stubbornness, he's actually pure-hearted and likes caring for others.

When Kyosuke exclaims that he'll "cheat" on Takara adult media and leaves the house, what will Takara do?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: This digital version includes four pages of special bonus content.

101365.description: High school freshman, Fujisawa Satou, was molested in a train one morning. However, that was only a misunderstanding on his part, and he eventually found out that it was only a racket. The one who informed him was Ayase Chihiro, the transfer student who started a month late. It was awkward between the two of them at first, but they gradually became closer.
synonyms: แม้ไม่รู้จักรัก

title.native: キスも知らないくせに

101366.description: It happened in a sunny day right before summer. Souta Fujisawa's first kiss was with his older classmate, Chihiro Ayase. It's now their summer vacation, and yet, nothing has happened between the two of them! What's worse, he discovers that he wasn't actually Ayase's first kiss, and now regrets kissing him.

title.native: 好きだからキスしたの？

101375.description:
Ethan lives a monotonous life trying to pay off his crippling debt—until the day Mike appears at the neighborhood laundromat looking worse for wear. Both men find themselves struggling to go on in different ways, and it's these struggles that bring them together while simultaneously threatening to tear them apart.

(Source: SuBLime)

101376.description: Koyuki Higashi and Hiroko Masahara's story of their decision to have a baby together, as a lesbian married couple. They previously chronicled their romance and wedding in Lesbian-teki Kekkon Seikatsu.

title.native: 女どうしで子どもを産むことにしました
title.romaji: Onna Doushi de Kodomo wo Umukoto ni Shimashita

101377.description: Yagami Touma became a delinquent after distancing himself from his childhood friend, Fuyu Atsushi, who wants to reconnect with him. The reason is something Touma could never reveal, he's actually in love with Atsushi. He ends up confessing on a whim, but Atsushi's answer is...?

101378.description:
City boy, Chiaki, was asked to take on a “Big Project” by his grandfather and sent to Tokachi, Hokkaido. However, upon his arrival to the project site, Chiaki is met with farming land full of cattle…the countryside?!

In order to help the spoilt Chiaki mature, his grandfather tells him to “earn enough money to pay for your flight home.”

In front of a hopeless Chiaki, appears the extremely tall, Soichiro, who was under the impression that he was going to be living with a girl who would be undergoing bridal training…?!

title.native: トーキョーボーイミーツカントリー

101383.description: Eternity doesn't mean simply to carry on living.

101388.description:
A love story of a university student who is on summer vacation and a manager of a 'Kominka' cafe.

Includes epilogue and a side story.
synonyms: Tomorrow  the Day After Tomorrow  and Then Someday

title.native: あしたあさってそれからいつか

101389.description: Ichigo Hoshimiya, now a top idol, moves to America to train and take part in concerts. Here she meets Marie, a Japanese-American 14-year-old girl who is getting to know Aikatsu and idols. Despite her mother's opposition, Marie decides to become an idol and starts training with Ichigo.

101390.description: In an all-girl school, there's a student everybody calls "Touma-kun". Each new chapter deals with a girl who fell in love with her.

101391.description:
When high schooler Haruka moves to Okinawa, she finds herself enamored with the beach right outside her front door and resolves to form a volleyball team with her cousin, Kanata. However, because she’s so short, Kanata gave up on volleyball ages ago. Can Haruka get her to take up the sport again in time for the junior tournament?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes 1 bonus chapter.

101392.description:
Trapped in a a dead-end job, Hayato Hitachi is a psychological wreck until a strange man saves him from drowning in the ocean. That man is none other than Taroi Urashima, a fairytale hero who's been living as Princess Otohime's bed-warmer for a thousand years! In exchange for a change in his fortune, Tarou agrees to take Hayato back to the surface, but when Hayato tries to scold the spoiled man, Tarou is instantly smitten. Hayato tries to use that infatuation to lure Tarou back to land, but Tarou is afraid of returning to human society, so he avoids the subject by pushing Hayato toward the bedroom every time...!! Will Hayato ever make it home, when he's so easily distracted...!?

(Source: Renta!)

101393.description:
1. Namae mo Shiranai Machiawase
Within the two seconds of us locking eyes, I see the invite and follow suit. There are many stories of one-night stands, but doing it in the bathroom at the station to my workplace? That’s a new one. And even when I’ve got a policy to never do the same guy twice, but I just couldn’t forget him. Then I meet him again exactly a week later, same place, same time. And we do it in the bathroom again!!

2. Machiawase no Sono Ato de
3. Mars no Shinzou no Hitosukui
4. Ijiwaru na Ko hodo Ijimetai
5. Mawarimichi shite Ano Ko no Tobira
6. Tokete Mazatte Natsu no Niwa
7. Machiawase no Sono Saki de
synonyms: Mawarimichi shite Ano Ko no Tobira

title.native: 名前も知らない待ち合わせ

101394.description:
1-3, 7. Aishigatari Monomanie
Higuchi Yuuya has been adopted by the son of the woman who caused an accident that killed his parents, Saeki Tooru. Both agree to live as a 'family.' As time flies by, both have developed feelings that can't be explained.
4-5. Himitsu Yuukaiten
6. Junketsu Sentimental

title.native: 愛したがりモノマニー

101396.description:
"Don't die!! I haven't told you I love you yet."

Salaryman Issei and self-proclaimed photographer Ban are sex friends. He loves Ban but is unable to tell him his feelings. Despite this, their relationship continued for a year. But just when Issei was about to confess, Ban dies in a traffic accident. In despair, Issei falls down the stairs and goes back in time to before Ban died...!?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Bokura wa Nandomo Koi o Suru

title.native: 僕らはなんども恋をする
title.romaji: Bokura wa Nando mo Koi wo Suru

101397.description: This is a story about a girl who likes another girl and tries her best to pursue her!

101398.description:
He falls asleep on the train as the storm rages outside against the shoulder of a man sitting next to him, and as this stranger calls out to him gently without getting angry, he finds himself desperately wanting to become an adult like this man as soon as possible… but the next time our hero sees this gentleman, he’s in a high school uniform!

(Source: Mangarock)
synonyms: Ii Ko Ii Ko Shite Ageru

title.native: いい子いい子してあげる

101399.description: Hotaruda is a budding shounen manga artist. His manuscript was rejected after visiting several publishers and was then referred to an ero manga publisher instead. Right after getting the job, he learns that his new editor Kayama is a masochistic pervert.

101400.description:
A collection of sweet Boys' Love stories.

1-2: Karasu to Kuma Soshite Sakana. (カラスと熊、そしてサカナ。)
After partying too much, and waking up naked in the morning, with a lot of used tissues lying around, Kogarasu and his two college friends have a supicion that they must have 'done it' last night. But who did it with whom?

3-4: Mujikaku Pizzicato (無自覚ピチカート)
Being an only child, Kei has always admired his "big brother," Hibiki. But when Hibiki's younger brother, Kanade, confesses his feelings to Kei out of the blue, Hibiki can't keep his composure anymore.

5: Osawari Suitchi (おさわりスイッチ)

Extra: Karasu no Issei (カラスの一声)

title.native: カラスと熊、そしてサカナ。

101401.description:
Assistant Professor Tachibana Yukinari is in love with his little brother. He left the house to hide his feeling, but his little brother Takayuki entered college where he teaches to follow his brother. Yukinari's heart would go fast just by a simple touch from Takayuki, when he thought he's hiding it well for others to know there's one student that noticed his feeling for Takayuki.

“Aren’t you crazy to lust over your little brother?” a student from psychology department Ichijou Kazusa started to threaten Yukinari….

(Source: Salty Potatoes)

title.native: 狂愛心理パラドックス

101402.description: Yuito didn't have a good first impression of the new transfer student, Tagasaki Mitsu, who bit him on their first encounter. There are a lot of rumors about Mitsu's violent ways, will Yuito find out whether they're true or not?

101403.description:
The story of a salary man named Fujisawa, who can't speak loud due to trauma and the one who wants to hear his voice the most, Kishino. Can Kishino cure Fujisawa's trauma?

(Source: Yaoi Otaku Translation)

101404.description:
Two endearing awkward men. Once they come face to face, Younosuke and Suzunari, both heirs of long-established tailors, immediately throw unpleasant sarcasms at each other. Just when Younosuke thought that their quarrelling relationship would go on forever, he was told to go for a marriage interview…

(Source: xiaojiangworld)

Note: Chapter count includes 1 extra.

101405.description: Tenma Madoka is the soon-to-be proprietor of his family's fireworks workshop,"Mantan ya". At his grandfather's retirement party, a handsome young man named Kikusawa Mitsuki pops up and claims to be grandpa's ex-lover!

101406.description:
Leo is a popular but self-conscious guy on campus who's been hiding the fact that he can't "get it up" lately. Not even therapy (porn) seems to help. At a party one night, he's forced to kiss his popular and irritating neighbor Ryosuke in front of everyone. Ryosuke's unexpectedly skillful tongue takes the lead, moving deeply inside Leo's mouth... Then Leo's body begins to react. Leo thought he had erectile dysfunction, so how can he be getting turned on in a situation like this...!?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.
synonyms: The Secrets Exposed with a Kiss
A Secret is Revealed with a Kiss
秘密はキスで暴かれる XOXO

title.native: 秘密はキスで暴かれる

101407.description:
After his death, Jian Chen’s soul was reincarnated into a foreign world. He grew up with swift speed, but at the end, because of overflowing enemies and from being heavily injured, his soul abnormally changed at the border of life and death. From then on, he stepped onto a completely different path of sword cultivation and became the Sword God of the generation.

(Source: Flower Bridge Too)

101408.description:
Zen Luo, who is now a menial slave, used to be a young master of a big family, owing to the decline of his family, his sister is imprisoned by a strong force, he has no choice but to be at others’ service. However, Every cloud has a silver lining, The ancient book left by his father actually conceals the magical spell, which can change a human into an instrument! What’s the mysterious power behind all these? This is contest with fate.

(Source: Webcomics)

Notes:
- Includes 16 extra chapters.
- Chapters 1 & 2 are each split into two parts.
synonyms: Apotheosis – The Endless Road to Divinity
Apotheosis – Elevation to the status of a god

title.english: Principles of Heavens: Zen’s Cultivation of Immortality

101412.description: Chiyo, who works as an animator in Tokyo, has a lover who is in a band.

101413.description: Mayu and Kiki are two middle school girls from Hokkaido who came to Harajuku as part of their school trip. Kiki ends up going to an Idol concert with her otaku friend Mayu. Will the happy-go-lucky Mayu and the left out Kiki be able to take a picture with her idol?

101414.description: Kishi-kun, who had no hopes or dreams, suddenly quit his job at an anime company. Chiyo-san, the girl he was interested in, worked there.

101415.description:
Mari Tamaki is in her second year of high school and wants to start something. It's then that she meets Shirase, a girl with few friends who's considered a weirdo by the rest of the class and nicknamed "Antarctica" since it's all she ever talks about. Unlike her peers, Mari is moved by Shirase's dedication and decides that even though it's unlikely that high school girls will ever go to Antarctica, she's going to try to go with Shirase.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: A Place Further than the Universe

101416.description:
Anton, the heir to the Arnault family, has finally come of age. As is customary for nobles, he is given access to the Cyrene Salon, a cafe filled with pleasure…and secrecy. After just one unforgettable evening with Arwin, the parlor’s “number one," the normally reserved Anton has soon become filled with lust and curiosity. Who is Arwin? How did he come to such a place? What is his connection to the head of the Arnault family? But most importantly, why can’t Anton get enough of him? Find all the answers in this erotic drama by the creator of “My Mother’s Lover.”

(Source: Lezhin)

101417.description: At the popular Japanese-style tea house Rokuhoudou, customers can count on receiving not only excellent food and drink, but - if they wish for it - a helping hand in solving any problem that may be plaguing them. Serving in Rokuhoudou are four men who are consummate professionals in their individual fields: tea expert Sui, latte artist Gure, pâtissier Tsubaki and chef Tokitaka.

101418.description:
Ju Seo-Cheon, a man who survives the age of war through sheer luck and becomes the elder of the Hwasan faction, only to live a life full of regrets and doubts. As he lies on his death bed, waiting for the inevitable, he is returned to the past...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: 废柴重生之我要当大佬

101419.description:
A meteorite carrying a deadly virus crashed into the earth's atmosphere and turned people into the walking dead... Ok, cliché aside—I clearly remembered I died years after the apocalypse, but why am I waking up this pre-doom high school room? What's worse, I've got only 90 minutes before that meteorite lands!

(Source: MangaToon)

101420.description:
Iori Igarashi, a rad tech with top-tier skills in imaging scans, is very socially awkward. He gets hired at the hospital where his beloved childhood friend, An Amakasu, works as a radiologist. Determined to support her in his role as a technologist, Iori gives his all—but she doesn’t seem to remember him…! Thus begins a medical comic about diagnostic imaging, where unseen illnesses are uncovered through the power of radiology!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.native: ラジエーションハウス

101421.description: Takahiro confessed to Kei and now they're going out (even if it's one-sided), but sex is strictly forbidden since their first attempt was too painful for Kei. Takahiro wants to try again and would do anything to change Kei's mind, even win a marathon.
synonyms: I Had Sex With My Best Friend

101422.description:
Leo's on his first hot springs trip with a lover, not caring about being in public and wanting only to act lovey-dovey, but because it's a relationship between men, his partner who is obsessed with appearances, puts a damper on things. While taking a walk Leo finds himself being ogled by a handsome man he meets. His friend having refused physical intimacy, he escapes from his room only to run into the hunky Ryouta again. Saying he's checking on his well being, he tries to seduce him, with the surprising hope that there will be an erotic turn of events...all the while with a smirk on his face! Under a superficial layer of kindness, Ryouta appears to have a bad personality.

(Source: Fujoshi Bitches)

101427.description:
Dog-lover Yuuto Shibamoto has recently taken to gazing at the German Shepherd who visits the convenience store he works at every morning. One day, he and the dog's owner, Ouki Inukai, are suddenly drawn together by fate! Why does Yuuto's heart race when he sees a rare smile on the gloomy man's face, and why can't he stop thinking about Ouki's large, masculine, athletic body...? Will romance blossom between this German Shepherd of a man and his little Shiba-Inu-sized friend!?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.
synonyms: Shiba-kun and Shepherd-san's Daily Life to be in Love

title.native: 柴くんとシェパードさん

101428.description:
Yuta, an orphaned teen, has a cute childhood friend and they live on the remote and mostly isolated Japanese island of Aoga. One day he encounters a strange fog and meets an apparent elf cosplayer.

(Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)
synonyms: Life as the Lord of Yngling with the Elven Bride

title.native: エルフ嫁と始める異世界領主生活
title.romaji: Elf Yome to Hajimeru Isekai Ryoushu Seikatsu

101433.description:
Kairi Amane is a detective who investigates ruthlessly and relentlessly. After he flashes a bag of drugs to a man in a nightclub, they move to a hotel for a steamy night. Though he approached the man, Tetsuo, for a reason, Tetsuo is himself a former detective who has his own reasons for going with Kairi.

The special unit of the First Investigation Division, also known as the Hood. Kairi and Tetsuo end up as partners within this organization, and start tracking down a string of murders connected to the illegal drug Maze. The two's hostile relationship takes an unexpected turn as they work together to solve the case...

A BL about two buddy cops, a lone wolf with a dark past and a competent and sadistic hedonist, working a case. Keri Kusabi's heart-rending erotica, brought to you by Qpa!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: メメントスカーレット

101434.description:
Leo Cornelia has dedicated her entire life to the battlefield. There is no demon she can't slay, no challenge she can't handle—at least, not until that confounding halfwit mage Foolie Dent confesses his love to her. Nothing feels farther from her than long-discarded notions of femininity and romance, but this annoying but dependable new friend might just be the key to opening the heart she closed long ago.

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: A Story About Treating a Female Knight Who Has Never Been Treated as a Woman as a Woman

title.english: How to Treat a Lady Knight Right
title.native: 今まで一度も女扱いされたことがない女騎士を女扱いする漫画
title.romaji: Ima made Ichido mo Onna Atsukaisareta Koto ga nai Jokishi wo Onna Atsukai Suru

101436.description:
Makino is a corporate spy who works under the guise of a part-time worker. He's sneaked into Prad., a big company headquartered in the United States. Things are going well until one day, Kamina, the new boss slated to become the next CEO, discovers his identity. From that day on, Makino is forced to live under Kamina's watch in his posh apartment, but the proximity may be too close for comfort...

(Source: Renta!)

101437.description:
Akira Shiroyanagi is a high schooler who loves challenging games and Konpeito candy. One day, while heading to school, he encounters an enigmatic woman called Mion. After that, Akira and a host of other individuals are kidnapped and forced to become test pilots for a mysterious organization. They are given unique abilities and pitted against each other. Armed with his newfound, special ability, Akira becomes determined to take down this sinister group and beat their game. He has to rely on his guile to overcome all sorts of obstacles in a captivating battle of wits!

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: ศึกเดือด 5 วิ พลิกชะตา

101438.description:
Inui works part-time as a tokusatsu hero in shows for children when he meets the Mugita family, a father and his son who have a lot of love for one particular ranger. As the Mugita family is always watching his shows with great passion, he gets interested in them and is happy when they invite him to their house. But while he enjoys spending time in their warm company, Inui is troubled because some desires in him awake when he thinks about Daddy-Mugita. Another story included is Aogeba Koishi, where a senpai and kohai from the middle school basketball club meet again as adults.

Note: Includes the one-shot "Aogeba Koishi (仰げば恋し)" and one extra chapter.

101439.description:
What’s it like spending your whole life coming in second place?

Ask Nam Jinwoo, he’s been living in the shadow of his rival, Ma Sangtae, his whole life. From high school to college, and now in the office. But passion is strange, it can start as envy or hate and turn into something… erotic. Now Jinwoo’s head is filled with the dirtiest and most erotic thoughts, none of which are in his control. More than anything, he wants them to stop. But the only way to stop them might just be the last thing he wants to do…

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Includes 29 extra chapters.

101441.description:
Yeonkwang Arts High School makes a clear distinction between the talented and the mediocre. The talented receive full benefits of the Gifted and Talented program—funding, training, opportunities to participate in exclusive art contests—while the mediocre are left to fend for themselves in the hopes that they, too, can one day make it into the prestigious program. Talent equals power in this competitive school, but when Chung-eun, a G/T student, falls for Yumi, a non-G/T student, the tables are turned. While Chung-eun is blinded by Yumi’s charms, Yumi’s got a hidden agenda.

(Source: Lezhin)

101442.description:
The TV star showed up and changed everything! A dazzling star appears in front of Ho-Soo, who lives his life for his sick little sister. It's the famous singer Esau, who is about to make a comeback soon. But Esau was facing a sudden crisis, as some woman appeared declaring to be his blood-related mother... Esau was going through so much pains behind all the stardom and Ho-Soo becomes the only one he can rely on. So, from that day on, Ho-Soo's life is anything but ordinary.

(Source: NetComics)

title.english: A Good Day to Go Crazy

101444.description: A 30-year-old business man makes a wish to be a girl. A chanting object runs toward him, and the next thing he knows he has became a loli elementary school girl.
synonyms: 今天开始当女子小学生

title.native: 女子小学生はじめました
フェンリル姉さんと僕
幼馴染はハチミツが好き

101447.description:
"I'm the type of person who has trouble entering a conversation."
Meet our protagonist, a meek, shy guy with no presence who has trouble speaking out. One day, he encounters a handsome but strange guy who seems to have an equally hard time in talking to others, and helps him out of a tight spot. As thanks, the bishounen blushes and hands his saviour some chocolates! Could this be the start of something unexpected for this tongue-tied duo...?

title.native: もっと話をしたいのだけど。
title.romaji: Motto Hanashi wo Shitai no Dakedo.

101448.description:
Noboru, who has an older brother that was an ex-actor, had a strong admiration for Kuriwaki Tsubasa, a Top Idol Actor. Every day he remembers his efforts for his acting career when he saw him long ago at the studio. But one day, when he returned to get the item he forgot in the classroom, he suddenly comes across Kuriwaki-kun dressed up as a girl?! Attempting to run, still in confusion, Noboru was hit by a blunt object and had his picture taken after receiving f***atioㅡ. “This is a secret between us.” Kuriwaki attends school dressed up as a girl due to circumstances. Kuriwaki is blackmailing under the name of “observation”. Noboru’s life of being Kuriwaki-kun’s underling starts!

(Source: Salty Potatoes)
synonyms: I Love the Rainbow Color of You

101449.description:
Fifteen-year-old Yuna prefers staying home and obsessively playing her favorite VRMMO game to doing anything else, including going to school. When a strange new update gives her a one-of-a-kind bear outfit that comes with overpowered abilities, Yuna is torn: the outfit is unbearably cute, but too embarrassing to wear in-game. But then she suddenly finds herself transported into the world of the game, facing down monsters and magic for real, and the bear suit becomes the best weapon she has!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: くま クマ 熊 ベアー

101450.description:
1-3) Kore ga Koi!
Uni student Hiroki goes shopping in female clothes because he lost in a punishment game. Suddenly he gets involved with some drunkards, but when they started to get violent, grim-looking high school teacher Kuga saved him. At first he only felt gratitude towards Kuga, but later Hiroki starts to get interested in him…!

4) Twinkle (KANDA Neko)
5) Dolce
6) ...Zutto
Extra

101451.description: In a fantasy world where monsters roam the land, the heroes party of Leon, Kijira and Ash traveled and slayed monsters together. But when Leon broke up with his partners so he could hang out with cute girls, Kijira and Ash starts carving their own legacy and it's one built on the back of jealousy as they look to overcome Leon in both monster slaying and women wooing.

title.native: 燃えるマッちゃん凍てつくハマちゃん

101455.description:
When shy and timid Eunseo was forced to transfer to the elite Stella Academy of the Arts, she expected lonely school days filled with cutthroat competition. So she's taken by surprise when the free-spirited Ina takes a sudden liking to her. The two girls become closer as they secretly meet on the rooftop after classes, and Eunseo's friendly admiration grows into something more. Luckily, Ina returns her feelings as well... but they seem to border on a dark obsession that grows larger by the day. What will happen when Eunseo discovers the hidden reason behind Ina's mysterious love?

(Source: Tappytoon)

101456.description:
In a quiet neighborhood, there's a small store where people too tired to remove their own makeup come to visit. Run by the cool and chic CEO "Huey" and her cheerful part-timer "Sooyeon", the makeup removal specialty shop named "Huey Soft Cleansing" soothes both the heart and skin of the customers who visit the shop. A romantic aesthetic romance for the clean and mature minded women!!

(Source: Lezhin US)

101457.description:
Yulha, who wants to escape from the reality of being the daughter of a member of the National Assembly, and Mina live in compliance with the reality while attending a bar. The two opposites are led by each other to taste the life they want for the first time... Is it a sad ending or a happy ending to give up reality to be together?

(Source: Lezhin)

101460.description:
This is a somewhat silly and sweet boy's love story. The all-round good student, Xu Qingsong (Christoph Sherman) got acquainted with a punk, Zhu Chen (Chet June), because of a fight and fell for him at first sight.

Because of various reasons, Xu Qingsong became the boss of a gang called the Seaflower Crew, and Zhu Chen became his right hand. Together they lead the Seaflower Crew to forcibly occupy... No, wait, to protect the town?

(Source: WebComics, edited)

101461.description: Suwa is a student with a crush on his teacher, Kannagi-sensei. Kannagi-sensei is handsome and gentle, with a voice that instantly arouses Suwa. Contrary to appearances, the teacher who looks like he has everything all together is actually an untidy person with no fashion sense, so Suwa must come to his classroom to take care of him. However, since Suwa has passed his class with flying colors, this relationship will soon be over. But on the last day of school, Kannagi-sensei suddenly says "I thought you loved me?" and forcibly kisses Sawa?!

title.native: 午前0時のオオカミ講師

101462.description: Akino absolutely despises his co-worker Kataoka, whose arrogant face makes Akino mad anytime they cross paths. One night, after drinking, Akino comes across Kataoka kissing another man! Ecstatic he finally found one of Kataoka's weaknesses, Akino believes he can use this for blackmail against the younger man. But, things do not go as he had planned and after the situation does a 180 degree turn, Akino declares "I will definitely make you say you like me!!" What will happen to these two co-workers, the playboy who claims to love no one and the fool of a man who will do anything to show his rival he is better?
synonyms: Turn 3 Times and Tell Me You Love Me

101463.description: Akihisa Hase was bullied for being an otaku, but the chance to change his appearance and start anew in a different school appeared when his father had to transfer. Going around the school, he found a volume of his favorite manga and got so entranced he didn't notice the owner of the manga, Yuu Onozuka, was right there and saw him on full otaku mode. Akihisa thought he had blown his cover, but Yuu was unexpectedly nice to him and they soon became friends. All was well until Akihisa became puzzled by the fact Yuu would randomly kiss him without saying anything.

101464.description: A manga part of the Uma Musume Project by Cygames, a game and an anime. It follows Special Week, an aspiring horsegirl athlete-idol, as she transfers in to the Traincent Academy to follow her dreams. But will she be able to withstand the competitive environment that awaits her there?

title.native: STARTING GATE! ―ウマ娘プリティーダービー―
title.romaji: Starting Gate!: Uma Musume Pretty Derby

101465.description: A comedic take on the daily lives of students in a co-ed high school.
synonyms: The Reality of a Co-ed High School

101466.description:
Hades has a crush on his capable attendant, but how should he interact with her?

Note: Includes 5 extra chapters
synonyms: Hades Could Use Some Divine Intervention

title.native: ハデスさまはお気の毒さま

101467.description: The romantic relationship between a naive yankee girl and a boy with seemingly no common sense.

title.native: ヤンキー西宮さんはちょろい

101468.description:
In a world full of dangerous monsters, our unnamed protagonist finds himself reborn at the very bottom of the food chain as an immobile, powerless egg. Even just hatching will require leveling up by fighting monsters–the same monsters who’d love to eat him as a snack. But with the help of the mysterious voice in his head, he’s determined to grow into the most powerful creature in the world!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
101468.hashtag: #転生したらドラゴンの卵だった
synonyms: Tensei Shitara Dragon no Tamago Datta: Saikyou Igai Mezasanee
Reincarnated as a Dragon's Egg: Let's Aim to be the Strongest

title.native: 転生したらドラゴンの卵だった ~最強以外目指さねぇ~
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Dragon no Tamago Datta: Saikyou Igai Mezasa Nee

101469.description:
One day when I got home as usual, what I saw was my classmate Sara in a maid costume. It seems like she's working at my house as a live-in maid...?!

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

101473.description: Eight is a boy who yearns to have a dream school life, for it applies several tests to enter any school. With all this, Eight can not enter any school, except a school that he does not remember having done the entrance exam, later on when he arrives this school will discover a world of super people with ideals and skills out of the ordinary.

101475.description:
Dongsoo's a loser, no doubt about it. He's unreliable, unemployed, and unlikely to get laid any time soon. At least, until he runs into Geumsil on a train to Seoul. Short skirt and and boob window aside, she's way out of Dongsoo's league. But, that all changes when an accident on the train embues Dongsoo and some other passengers on the train with a thousand years worth of sexual spiritual energy. The thing is, there's only one way to release the energy. Time to hang out with your yang out.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

101476.description:
Cheoljoong Gang, a problem-solver and a private eye, has the ability to use secret powers. After stumbling upon a college girl abduction case, Cheoljoong senses that his past has something to do with those behind the kidnappings…

(Source: Copin Comics)

101477.description:
Jinsoo, an engineer specializing in augmented reality, has always dreamed of using the technology in creative ways. So when Solmi, a camgirl, asks him to develop adult content for her live stream show, he’s presented with the opportunity of a lifetime. He finally has enough money to research and design at his will, whether it be holographic clothes that allow people to walk around naked in public, or gadgets that boost orgasmic pleasure. Tune in to Solmi’s channel for some hot, high-tech porn.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 10 side stories.

101479.description: At the end of summer, Tachibana Souhei went to the French countryside armed with only his camera after his heart was broken. However, while there, he got into an accident. Right after the accident, he meets a Japanese native on vacation with his mother named Machida Lucas. Not even a few hours after meeting, Lucas tells Souhei he know he's into men and kisses him! Unable to refuse, Souhei goes along with Lucas for some "fun". And Shouhei lets Lucas in on his most kept secret: He can only come if he is tied up! But will this last more than just this one day on the French countryside, or will it become something more?

101480.description:
Is it ever too late to make up for a lie? Or can the opportunity be swept away, like white clouds across a blue summer sky?

It's been seven years since Hozumi left behind the island town he grew up in, and Mishima—his close friend and first love from high school—with it. The two haven't spoken since Hozumi rejected Mishima and lied about his own feelings. When Hozumi returns for his high school reunion, he wants nothing more than to make amends, a task easier said than done.

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: The Blue and White That Separate Us
Bokura o Hedateru Ao to Shiro

title.english: The White and Blue Between Us
title.romaji: Bokura wo Hedateru Ao to Shiro

101482.description: In kingdom era 408, the prince led five heroes to the defeat of the Demon King and ascended the throne. Eight years later, he passed away from illness. One day, several years later, Tifa was separated from her father Chris at the market, kidnapped by a human-trafficking group made up of disguised demons! To protect his daughter, Chris is forced to reveal powers that he has hidden for a long time… There seems to be a connection between this former noble and the heroes! What are the daily lives of the retired heroes like?

101483.description: According to tradition, witches are supposed to be wed to demons as wives; the more magical power contained by the witches, the higher they are sought after by the demon races for prestige, power, bloodline, and fame. 16 year-old Sunya Velladonna decided to break this forced marriage herself, forced onto her by the demon world, and decided to escape to the human realm - only to end up as a runaway bride. While in the human realm, she encountered a recently divorced young doctor, Othder Hurvenss. In order not to be caught and sent back to demon realm, Sunya took the opportunity to make a magic marriage contract with Dr. Othder while he was sleeping. One of them is an escapee from a forced marriage, while the other is one who fell out of love, a disillusioned doctor. With both of them facing marital difficulties and having coincidentally met each other, what will happen to this pair and will occur?

101485.description:
Lately, Shirasaka, a high school student has become anxious and restless. The reason being, is because his close friend Kuroda who is better than him in school and sports suddenly grew making him look more mature and he feels as though he will be left behind. One day after school when club activities ended, Shirasaka who still has feelings of anxiousness was napping and was suddenly kissed by Kuroda…!?

(Source: Yaoi Desire Revolution)

101486.description: Nakahara is an editor in charge of Kuroki, a popular novelist. To help him write his work, he would offer his body to have the same experiences as the protagonist in Kuroki's story. Meanwhile, a film adaptation of Kuroki's novel was announced. Yoshizaki, in charge of sales, came from another branch for the project and tries to reveal Kuroki's relationship, but...

101487.description:
The unbalanced relationship between a dominating, manipulative erotic novelist and his new editor, who also happens to be his most loyal fan.

1. Shousetsuka ni Koi shitara (小説家に恋したら, If You Fall in Love with a Novelist)
2. Shousetsuka no Shitsukekata (小説家の躾け方, How to Discipline a Novelist)
3. Shousetsuka no Aishikata (小説家の愛し方, How to Love a Novelist)
4. Summer Garden Beach (サマー・ガーデン・ビーチ)
5. Utsukushii Kago (美しい籠, Beautiful Cage)
6. Itsuka no Umi he (いつかの海へ, Someday, to the Beach)
synonyms: If You Fall in Love with a Novelist

101488.description:
1-2. Zigzag Heartbeat (ジグザグ・ハートビート)
3-5. Shuwashuwa, Kirari (しゅわしゅわ、きらり)
On the summer vacation of their third year high school, Kei went to visit Koai island to meet his friend, Kou, who he have been exchanging letters with. They reunited for the first time in 12 years, Kou has plenty of friends, a complete opposite from Kei. At first, Kei is bewildered that Kou in person actually wasn’t as approachable as he was in his letters but as they share their memories together, little by little, they open up to each other. The friendship they fostered in peace changes its shape by a kiss from mere curiosity.

6. Enkyori Renai (遠距離恋愛)
synonyms: ジグザグ・ハートビート

101489.description: In this country, there exists a god called the “batsu”. And a surreal and beautiful batsu called Rei is the master of a servant called Theo. Their roles were passed down from generations in their family, but their relationship gradually turns to love as Theo’s desire to stay together grow stronger day by day. When he feels the warmth of Rei’s body, he feels comfort. However, batsu age several times faster than normal humans, and Theo will also eventually outlive Rei.

101490.description:
1. Goodbye My God
2. Bokura no Hahen
3. Mr. Wonderland
4. Anata no Sekai de Owaritai

title.native: あなたの世界で終わりたい

101491.description:
1. An no Niwa
2. Futari de Akete
3. Kanojo no Hahen
4. Ame
5. After the Fuschia

title.native: あの子に優しい世界がいい
title.romaji: Ano Ko ni Yasashii Sekai ga Ii

101492.description:
The moon always shines on the same place, so I'm alright.

Mitsuki, who had gone from the countryside to Tokyo, is reunited with his childhood friend Kiyozi after 10 years.

After 10 years, the wall from time is not felt in the natural conversation, livelihood and sex.

It appears as if the two had gone back to the past when they would run around playing. However, the Kiyozi who was worry free and used to laugh innocently, has become a person who is somewhat aloof and has a lonely expression as if something has ended.

The past Mitsuki had with Kiyozi makes Mitsuki experience various emotions....

title.native: 月を泣いて欲しがる君

101493.description:
Tomo, Niina and Megu are three high schoolers who're determined to become idols. Is it because they want to bring joy to young women all over the country? Because they dream of being top singers and actors one day? It's nothing so pure or so ambitious...These boys just want to get laid!

But to that end, it's necessary to beat all the "real" idols out there and rise to the top in terms of popularity. So they enter "Maji Kou", short for Majima Kita All-Boys High School... And all hell breaks loose!

title.native: 俺たちマジ校デストロイ

101495.description:
"Is this enough for you to promise not to tell anybody what you saw...?" One evening, ordinary and completely straight college student Serizawa comes across two men kissing in a dark alleyway. As he attempts to walk away unnoticed, he recognizes one of the men as professor Utsumi; a lecturer at his college. Serizawa finds himself becoming interested in the love life of Utsumi, who is well-known for his iron mask and expressionless demeanor. In exchange for keeping Utsumi's secret, Serizawa invites him out for drinks. Later that night, Serizawa misses his last train home, and ends up dozing off at Utsumi's house. He wakes up, and, to his surprise, Utsumi is going down on him! A bittersweet, impure love story between a student and his plain yet erotic professor.

(Source: Renta!)

101502.description:
Sei, a 20-year-old office worker, is whisked away to a whole new world. Unfortunately for Sei, the ritual that summoned her—meant to produce a “Saint” who would banish the dark magic—brought two people over instead of one. And everyone prefers the second girl over Sei?! But this is just fine by Sei, who leaves the royal palace to set up shop making potions and cosmetics with her newfound magic. Business is booming, and this might not be such a bad life, after all…as long as her supposed Sainthood doesn’t come back to haunt her.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The Power of the Saint is All Around
The Saint's Magic Ability is Omnipotent
สตรีศักดิ์สิทธิ์อิทธิฤทธิ์สารพัดอย่าง

title.english: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent
title.native: 聖女の魔力は万能です
title.romaji: Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou desu

101503.description:
Sei, a 20-year-old office worker, is whisked away to a whole new world. Unfortunately for Sei, the ritual that summoned her—meant to produce a “Saint” who would banish the dark magic—brought two people over instead of one. And everyone prefers the second girl over Sei?! But this is just fine by Sei, who leaves the royal palace to set up shop making potions and cosmetics with her newfound magic. Business is booming, and this might not be such a bad life, after all…as long as her supposed Sainthood doesn’t come back to haunt her.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The Power of the Saint is All Around
The Saint's Magic Ability is Omnipotent

title.english: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent
title.native: 聖女の魔力は万能です
title.romaji: Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou desu

101504.description:
Sakura has been called 'beautiful' countless times. The only other person to rival him in that aspect is Yukihira. Sakura fell for him at first sight to the point he stalks Yukihira almost every day and attempts to confess despite being socially awkward. When one of his attempts to get closer to Yukihira resulted in a kiss, Sakura may have awakened a different side of the princely Yukihira.

(Source: Futekiya)
synonyms: He's Mean Because He Likes You

title.english: Love Blooms for a Twisted Blossom
title.native: ひねくれさくらに恋が咲く
title.romaji: Hinekure Sakura ni Koi ga Saku

101507.description:
As far as anyone can tell, Jae-Hee is a shy, hard-working high school teacher. Once she's behind closed doors and drawn curtains, Jae-Hee enjoys spending her time kneeling at the end of a whip. And no one enjoys holding the handle more than her childhood friend, Hui-Lin. But when Sul-Hwa starts her position as a student-teacher at the school, secrets and feelings long buried start to surface. Now, Jae-Hee's about to learn just how much pleasure she can pull from pain.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

101508.description:
Logan's come home for summer break, and he's depressed. He'd always dreamed of a college life of non-stop banging, and yet he's never even gotten to first base. Girls run away when he tries to pick them up. Then... he meets up with his quirky childhood friend Daniel, whom he hasn't seen in ages. Logan vents about having never been kissed, and to his shock, Daniel offers himself up for practice!! Logan laughs it off at first, but out of desperation not to end his youthful days untouched, he finally agrees. But, turns out Daniel is an amazing kisser...! An inexperienced college student fumbles his way into intimacy with his nerdy, closet-bottom friend!!

(Source: Renta!)

101509.description:
Michael goes to the human world to look for an old friend, and save the world together, but the reincarnated Lucifer can no longer remember him……

(Source: MR)

101510.description: After being placed in a different class from his usual group of friends, all Do Jihwan wants is to spend an uneventful and quiet year in school. That plan goes down in shambles upon meeting one Kang Chanyoung, a popular and up-to-beat guy who has no qualms in saying what’s on his mind.

101511.description:
Face it, high school's hard. From friends to grades to looks, everything matters. Luckily, Ha Nami's got most of that taken care of. Her grades are at the top of her class, she's got two loyal friends, and she's pretty to boot. Unfortunately, she's also got a curse. One that makes it impossible for her to talk to anyone she likes. Like... "like" likes.

(Source: Lezhin US)

101512.description:
A man who gets neglected at home and at work. The loser's rebellion has now begun.

(Source: TOPTOON+)
synonyms: Looser ~上司のセフレは俺の妻~

101513.description: It has been a year since Li Fu Chen lost his “Talent”. Now he lives the life of a trash, being bullied and beaten by those who once was inferior to him. However, he still has not lost everything as he’s still engaged to a strong and pretty girl of a powerful family, but that came to an end as the engagement was abruptly cancelled. With shame brought to the family and his life engulfed by darkness, a ray of hope pierced the the sky.

101515.description: After a few years, our main character Jinguu Masato, returns home. Due to his nature, he loves animals and he also likes to visit them. Because of this, he loved to visit the zoo since he was small and that's how he developed a close relationship with Hanayo. However, Masato gradually starts to notice some strange incidents happening in the zoo and after that, he's thrown into this unexpected world...

101516.description:
A couple thousand years of solitude would wear down any young man—that is, anyone except Asley, an eternally youthful and eternally foolish sorcerer. After all, he has man's best friend...er, familiar, to keep him company. When his Level 100 canine companion Pochi demands that he get some fresh air for the first time in two centuries, Asley sets out to reintegrate into society and test his magic mettle. His mission? Dropping several unglamorous titles from his repertoire and restoring his good (okay, decent) name.

A brand-new world and fresh adventures await Asley after his many years of hermitage. Perhaps he'll lend Pochi a hand to place first in the mysterious Familiar Feud. Or maybe he'll lose all vestiges of dignity and turn tail. Whichever comes first! No matter what, Asley has great evil to fight, a big world to save, and even a little growing up to do...that is, if he can endure Pochi's “friendly advice” along the way!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The Principle of a Philosopher by Eternal Fool "Asley": The great adventure of Pochi

title.english: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure
title.native: 悠久の愚者アズリーの、賢者のすゝめ ―と、ポチの大冒険―
title.romaji: Yuukyuu no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume: to, Pochi no Daibouken

101517.description:
Although Yuji Itadori looks like your average teenager, his immense physical strength is something to behold! Every sports club wants him to join, but Itadori would rather hang out with the school outcasts in the Occult Research Club. One day, the club manages to get their hands on a sealed cursed object. Little do they know the terror they’ll unleash when they break the seal…

(Source: VIZ Media)

Notes:
- Ranked 1st in Japan's Bookstore Employees Top Manga of 2018.
- Nominated for the 25th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2021.
- Nominated for the 65th Shogakukan Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2019.
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: มหาเวทย์ผนึกมาร

101518.description: Ryutaro Saeki (32) was divorced and return to living alone again. He is quick to find a suspicious cheap property, but in that room, he was greeted by Zashiki Warashi. Bizarre and funny life of two people living together will start!
synonyms: A Zashikiwarashi Lives in that Apartment

title.native: そのアパート、座敷童子付き物件につき・・・
title.romaji: Sono Apato, Zashikiwarashi-Tsuki Bukken ni Tsuki...

101519.description: 20-year-old Michiru Amatsuki moved to Tokyo due to a change of career. She decided to live in a woman-only share house "Stella House Haruno" with people of different age and occupations. It's always fun when there's delicious alcohol and meal!!

101521.description:
A man dies alone after living a stagnant and fruitless life—but that's not where his story ends, as a boy named William is born into a land of fantasy and magic. Raised in a city of the dead by his new family—a mummy, a skeleton, and a ghost—he can remember glimpses of his past life, enough to know his time on Earth was wasted, and he vows not to let that happen again. Schooled in magic and combat, Will sets out on a journey to see the world. Along the way, he'll meet beings of all shapes and sizes. Each of these people has a story to tell and a lesson to teach Will about how to live his life to the fullest.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

101522.description:
To prove whether he was a homosexual, Qiu Zinan decided to dress like a woman and go to a bar. There he “was seduced to the bedroom” by a handsome stranger. Feeling reluctant on the bed, Zinan revealed his true identity, but all they could hear later were the hard breath of one another, and that was how the game began!!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I Fell In Love With My Girlfriend's Brother
Kanojo no Otouto ni Koi Shite
I Fell In Love With Girlfriend's Brother
Fell in Love with GF's Brother

title.english: Fell in Love with Girlfriend's Brother
title.romaji: Wo Ai Shang Le Nü You De Di Di

101527.description:
"Heartthrob idol Shiina Canan accidentally helps Masaomi Mouze; a man who collapsed in front of him. Mouze in a rush of gratefulness, kneels down and requests to "Return his gratitude". When Mouze's manly body and back tattoo caught Canan's eye, he offers Mouze to live with him as his bodyguard to return the favour. A dutiful sense of gratitude X A bitch hidden behind a heartthrob facade."

A dutiful sense of gratitude x A bitch hidden behind a heartthrob facade.
This is a dramatic story about two people with perfect physical attraction.

title.native: オレを守ると誓ってよ

101528.description: When Makita Maki, Hasebe Kokoa, and Tachibana Rinka are hit by a truck, they're transported to an unknown location. After fooling around, they eventually figure out that they're in another world. With their phones still connected to Twitter, now they must try and live in this fantasy world.
synonyms: Gal Tensei: Isekai Seikatsu Maji Darui

title.native: ギャル転生 ～異世界生活マジだるい～

101529.description:
An invincible brother who's willing to do anything for his little sister.

Note: Chapter count includes 5 extra chapters.

101530.description: The Yiqi who sees the other personal memories when they lock lips, falls in love with a time traveling prince. In order to retrieve his memories, the prince kisses her without hesitation. And the person in his memories looks exactly like Yiqia. Hurry and read this kissing-from-beginning-to-end manhua, an excellent time-travel story full of embarrassing and slightly masochistic scenes.

101531.description:
Suenobu Mako is dragged out to a nightclub by his best friend and somehow ends up bringing home Hiro, a flashy guy he encounters there. However, Hiro leaves the next day without saying a word. Meanwhile, Mako encounters his ideal man in the form of the diligent salaryman, Fukamachi?!

(Source: Koe-Iro Translations)

title.native: 憧れのろくでもない人

101532.description:
1. Yuuwaku Tsundereation
2. Hotteokenai-kei Danshi
3. Sonogo Hotteokenai-kei Danshi
4-5. Boku to Kimi to Midoriiro no Yakusoku
6. Boku no Kawaii Mahoutsukai
synonyms: Boku to Kimi to Midoriiro no Yakusoku

title.native: 誘惑ツンデレーション

101533.description:
Kanata is cheerful and friendly. kasumi who can only look at the senpai she love from afar, is very inexperienced in love and her heart thumped unstopably by kanata closeness ...!? Friendly boy and inexperienced in love girl, a refreshing heart thumping love!

(Source: Chibi Manga)

101534.description:
Misaki Ogawa can't help getting hit on by all the boys in her school because of her mature-looking appearance. But she's always been in love with her hero, her childhood friend, the short but strong Issei who's always protected her.

Included one-shots:
Yumemigachi Honey
Suki tte Ienai Ryouomoi.

title.native: だって… 我慢できないっ

101535.description: Heart-throbbing first love story of a baseball club's hard-working manager Aoi and its ace Kanzaki!

title.native: シュガーボールダイアリー－坂高野球部恋愛日誌－
title.romaji: Sugar Ball Diary: Hankou Yakyuubu Renai Nikki

101536.description:
A naked hunk appeared, out of nowhere, in my house... and he can control ice?! Thus, the money-minded female master now uses him as a moneymaking machine. They slowly fall in love with each other after being together, but the 'Snow Man' has a condition that makes him unable to love. How will they overcome this problem and will they find true love?

Note: Includes a prologue and 8 side stories.

101538.description:
Volume 1
1-2. Chou to Hana no Kankeisei (蝶と花の関係性); Reijin uno! Vols. 49, 51
Sakutarou Hanada, a new employee at a company, meets the carefree yet earnest Chouno, who is different from the strict seniors he had before... in more ways than one.

3. Himitsu no Koi no Todokesaki (秘密の恋の届け先); Reijin uno! Vol. 45
4-5. Kimi ga Sunao ni Nareru made (きみがすなおになれるまで); Reijin uno! Vols. 46, 57
6. Chou to Hana to Sunao ni Nareta Koibitotachi (蝶と花とすなおになれた恋人達); kakioroshi

Volume 2
7, 10-12. Chou to Hana no Chuudokusei (蝶と花の中毒性); Reijin uno! Vols. 72, 86, 96, kakioroshi
8-9. Chou to Kumo no Su (蝶と蜘蛛の巣); Reijin uno! Vols. 78-79
synonyms: きみがすなおになれるまで
Kimi ga Sunao ni Nareru made
きみがすなおになれたとき
Kimi ga Sunao ni Nareta Toki

101539.description:
Yoshi, a student in an all-boys high school find his only solace in Urakawa-sensei, the school's nurse. Urakawa is a fresh breath of air with his gentle demeanor and attractive appearance. But there's more than meets the eye as sensei seems to be close to another student named Sugao. Yoshi is in for a big shock as he learns things he wished he never did.

(Source: Manga Club)

101540.description: Nishikado Taketora is a high schooler with piercings, blond hair, and scary facial features. Even though he only wants to be normal, he keeps getting involved with yankees. Despite of all that, this fierce tiger spots someone that's totally his type!
synonyms: 若き猛虎くんの悩み(続)

101541.description:
Office worker Arisawa thinks that love is troublesome, so he keeps having one-night stands. But he and university student Tomohiro have something between them after Tomohiro drags him out of the bar. It was just supposed to be one of Arisawa's usual one-night stands but Tomohiro says, "Let's go out!" Of course, Arisawa immediately declines. But due to Tomohiro's persistent words, they end up dating for two months as a trial?

(Source: Kaiousha, translated)

Included one-shots: Nozomeba Eien (望めば永遠), Sonna no wa Sasai na Koto (そんなのは些細なこと)
synonyms: Sonna no wa Sasai na Koto

101542.description: Asakura, a writer, coincidentally came across high-schooler Mihara who has feelings for his male friend. He sees himself in Mihara because of his bitter past love. By a twist of fate, it turns out that Mihara's homeroom teacher, Mizumori, is the very person he loved!

101543.description: Yuu. Nice face, tall, big, dog-like and popular with the female classmates. And I, who have an immense feeling of superiority at being embraced by such a guy. More-than-friends for whom time and place don't matter? It's pleasant showing affection, and when we realize it, our hearts beat faster, but isn't such a relationship between men strange? And despite that?
synonyms: If You Not Angry, Please Face Here

title.native: おこってないならこっちむいて

101544.description: Shouta Sakura does a shady part time job where he gets people to break up with another person. This time's target is a certain man named Kazuya Yuushima who's having an affair with a rich lady, and her folks want them to break up, which is why they employ Sakura's agency's services. Upon meeting this "Kazuya," Sakura soon realizes that he might just be the total opposite of what he thought he was going to be. He gets him to sleep with him in order to blackmail him in the end, and all was fine until he falls for Kazuya's talks of destiny! That and it turns out that he slept with the real target Kazuya's twin brother who also bore the same name!
synonyms: The Effect of Love and Sex and Magic

title.romaji: Koi to Sei to Mahou no Sayou

101545.description: Hyakka is the guardian diety of the newly developed Ayasaki village. She's a freeloader who lives in the village's only cafe, Warabi. Like Ayasaki itself, her powers are still developing. As such, she has to draft the son of Warabi's owner, Akira, into helping her with her daily efforts.

101548.description:
State trooper Brandt’s new assignment to infiltrate a sex-cam operation puts him in a very uncomfortable position, especially since he’ll have to perform naked on camera for his audition. Fortunately his partner and best friend, Donnelly, has his back—whether that means helping Brandt shop gay boutiques for sexy underwear or offering Jäger and encouragement while he researches porn. Despite his mortification, Brandt gives the audition his best “shot”—and becomes an overnight sensation. But to meet the man behind the operation, he'll have to give a repeat performance, this time live on webcam opposite the highest bidder. Donnelly makes sure to win that auction for his partner’s sake, but their plan has a flaw: faking it is not an option. In the aftermath, Brandt is a humiliated mess trying desperately to come to terms with what he’s had to do for the job and his own mixed feelings. But Donnelly has been on a journey of discovery of his own. Suddenly everything the two men thought they knew about themselves and each other gets turned inside out. Meanwhile, they still have a case to solve… but it may not be the case they thought it was.

(Source: Source: Dreamspinner Press)

101551.description:
After his professor is injured, rookie linguist Hakaba is entrusted with his work, a research trip to study the language of monsters. Travelling together with his guide Susuki, he dives into the complex world of interspecies communication!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

title.native: ヘテロゲニア リンギスティコ ～異種族言語学入門～

101552.description: The manga follows the daily lives of Kou, a slightly quirky man, and his wife, Yukio (often called Yuki), who is a cross dressing man. Read as this married couple handles the trouble that comes with cross dressing in modern Japanese society.

101553.description:
Eguchi Hajime is a normal primary school boy you can find anywhere, but compared to his peers he is a little different. No slightly erotic moment of daily life, no matter how small can escape the attention of his eyes.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.
synonyms: เองุจิคุงไม่เคยพลาด

title.native: 江口くんは見逃さない

101556.description:
The continuation of the Kaiji series, picking up immediately after the end of One Poker Hen.

One Poker has been concluded, with Kaiji emerging as the victor and claiming the 2.4 Billion Yen as a prize! But now, a new problem arises... how can the Asian Trio take it with them with Kazuya's Black Suits gathered right outside the entrance of the warehouse?!

Chapter count for this arc begins at 255 in the original tankoubon.
synonyms: Gambling Outcast Kaiji: The 2.4 Billion Escape Arc

title.native: 賭博堕天録カイジ 24億脱出編

101557.description:
Ichikawa Kyoutarou, a boy barely clinging to the bottom rung of his school’s social ladder, secretly believes he’s the tortured lead in some psychological thriller. He spends his days dreaming up ways to disrupt his classmates’ peaceful lives and pining after Anna Yamada, the class idol. But Kyotaro’s not nearly the troubled teen he pretends to be…and it turns out Anna’s a bit odd herself!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Notes:
- Winner of the Tsugi ni Kuru Web Manga 2020 Award.
- Nominee for the 2020 Manga Taisho Award.
synonyms: The Bad Part of My Heart
เธอผู้อันตรายต่อใจผม

title.romaji: Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu

101558.description: Akihito woke up to find himself naked and restrained. In front of him was a young man who insisted that he himself had agreed to be in that kind of situation. Full of objections, he was told "I'll teach you how to bring out your real charm" by some man he'd met at a gay bar and with that, he thought about giving in.

101559.description: The latest horror series from Rei Mikamoto. Follows Mio Amasato, a high school girl who controls a bizarre mechanical doll.
synonyms: A Girl of the Iron Ghost

title.native: アイアン・ゴーストの少女

101560.description:
Bae Songwoo is in a one-sided love with his longtime friend, Kim Sangjin. Living his life hiding his feelings, one day Bae Songwoo finds a suspicious book in his house, and written inside is Kim Sangjin's life story.
But Bae Songwoo is just a passing extra...?!
As he tries to ignore the book, Bae Songwoo soon realises that everything is going as written...

101561.description: After the death of her parents, Kanami Tachibana's once kind older brother suddenly changes for the worse, leaving her to fend for herself. When Makoto Asahi finds her like this, he offers up to become a brother to her. Kanami, feeling the kindness she once felt with her brother and scared to forget her sibling, offers to pay him money for this deed. As their bond strenghtens and Kanami gets to see more of the world than ever, will she get back the kind brother she once loved?

title.native: レンタルおにいちゃん

101562.description:
Adjusting to a new school is always rough, and that goes double for Sakura, a shy human who is transferred to an academy that’s monster girls only! Sakura’s new classmates include a kiss-curious harpy, a sarcastic lamia, a cyclops who has her eye on Sakura, and a plain-spoken centaur who treads cautiously down hallways full of lusty demons. Eager to blend in, and with a body that convinces, Sakura lies and declares herself a succubus. But can she keep up the ruse, and keep her new friends’ hands, claws, and scaled coils off her? It’s going to be one long, hot school year!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: サキュバスじゃないもん！

101563.description:
Feared and hated for his sinister abilities, Wei Wuxian–the grandmaster of demonic cultivation–was driven to his death when the most powerful clans united to destroy him.

Thirteen years later, Wei Wuxian is reborn. Summoned by a young man who sacrificed his soul in a forbidden ritual, Wei Wuxian is now bound to seek vengeance on the stranger’s behalf or risk the destruction of his own soul. But when an evil entity emerges, a familiar face from Wei Wuxian’s past suddenly appears amidst the chaos–Lan Wangji, a powerful cultivator who will help shine a light on the dark truths that surround them.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Le Grand Maître de la Cultivation Démoniaque

title.english: Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation: Mo Dao Zu Shi

101564.description:
The current heiress had her identity changed? I suffered humiliation when I returned to my birth family? My childhood sweetheart betrayed me for my younger sister? And not only did someone harm me, causing me to lose my unborn child, but I was also exiled by my family? Could I be any more unfortunate?
But don't worry. Wait until I've entered that mysterious organization -- I'll become a new person, make a strong return, and start planning my revenge! But then a certain man -- a company president and single father -- asked me to live with him? What in the world is going on?!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Full Marks Hidden Marriage: Pick Up a Son, Get a Free Husband

101565.description:
Hina has no shortage of girls hitting on him-it's keeping them that's a problem. He starts working at a bar because he falls in love with the food the quiet and unfriendly guy Chi makes there. Hina thinks this will be the start to a new work life outside of his studies... but then... Chi gets drunk and kisses him passionately and really well, too...! Hina feels so awkward about it, he starts avoiding Chi (who doesn't remember kissing him at all) until one day, Chi calls him out on it and makes him talk...!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 僕の可愛い酔っぱらい

101566.description:
With advancements in soul technology, humans on the continent of Douluo conquered the oceans and discovered two new continents. The soul beasts have also been hunted to the brink of extinction by human soul masters. The king of soul beasts awakens in the depths of the Great Star Dou Forest to lead remaining clan members to seek vengeance against humankind! Tang Wulin aspires to be a powerful soul master, but when his martial soul awakens, it turns out to be……, Prodigy of an era, battle of the Dragon King, the legend of the Dragon King henceforth begins.

(Source: Wutopia Comics)
synonyms: Soul Land III - The Legend of the Dragon King
Douluo Dalu III - The Legend of the Dragon King
Douluo Dalu III: Long Wang Chuanshuo

title.english: Soul Land 3: Legend of the Dragon King

101567.description:
"You have a nice body."
With that, the associate professor offers him a part time job... looking after him......!

Shattered by the losses of his two-year relationship and nine-year job, Asahi has nowhere to go. But when his father is hospitalized, he ends up helping at his parents' restaurant. There, he meets professor Yuzuru Togame, who is slouching and scoffing down his food. Despite being seven years Asahi's senior, Yuzuru turns out to be pretty hopeless as he eats with his chopsticks clenched in his fist, and then falls asleep mid-meal! Asahi accepts Yuzuru's offer of a part-time job without much thought, but......!?

This is a case study in love, between a broken-hearted but meddlesome younger man, and a hapless professor.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
